title: Janine Johnston
description: "This decadent character appears briefly in JEDI," explains Janine Johnston. "I believe her name is Yarna." Johnston's first comics project was TALES OF THE JEDI with Tom Veitch, which was followed by the first issue of ELFQUEST: BLOOD OF TEN CHIEFS. She is now the regular cover artist for both that series and POISON ELVES, from Mulehide Graphics. Johnston's next project is an illustrated hardcover book with ELFQUEST creator Wendy Pini.
